fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer's long-term legacy loans fell sharply, as shown in its 31 March 2025 balance sheet, according to the analyst.

fact_text: The analyst says Fatima Fertilizer's cash and urea operations leave room for a half-year dividend, in addition to its year-end payout.

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer has started paying dividends twice a year, which the analyst regards as a positive for dividend-focused investors.

fact_text: The analyst names Fauji Fertilizer, Engro Fertilizers and Fatima Fertilizer as fertilizer companies that have paid high dividends for years.

fact_text: Engro Polymers was a top pick for most brokerages around 2021-2022, when its PVC margins from ethylene-based production were strong.

fact_text: Engro Polymers' primary margins have fallen from the 2021-2022 levels, and the analyst will watch how sales respond to its new H2O2 line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '🔴 Midday Flash | 14 July 2025 | Fatima Fertilizer to Lead PIA Bid? 💰✈️' (YouTube, 2025-07-14)

fact_text: Gas supply problems caused losses and weak operations at Engro Polymers, and PVC demand was soft because construction activity stayed weak, per the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '🔴 Midday Flash | 14 July 2025 | Fatima Fertilizer to Lead PIA Bid? 💰✈️' (YouTube, 2025-07-14)

fact_text: The analyst expects better PVC demand if construction picks up in Punjab and Sindh, as the FY26 budget signalled for the construction sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '🔴 Midday Flash | 14 July 2025 | Fatima Fertilizer to Lead PIA Bid? 💰✈️' (YouTube, 2025-07-14)

fact_text: Chlor-alkali electrolysis at Engro Polymers yields caustic soda (NaOH) and five or six other chemicals as by-products; the company has added hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) production.

fact_text: Hydrogen peroxide is widely used as a bleaching agent in composite textile processing, which gives peroxide producers a demand source beyond PVC.
